gameplay.note: First bumper step overlaps startup resets; only the matching special response is attributed to its closure. Credits 6/7 increment on coin and decrement on Start; ball 4/5 becomes 1 with a blank tens digit.

solenoid.note: Displayed selectors at indices 4/5, Test 02 at 6/7. Pulses are retained in raw steps; display number alone is not physical fitment.

switch.limitation: Host states excluded from observed switches. Repeated 43 host pulses and stale 43 for 44-64 do not establish driveability/fitment.
